book.burningdownthehouse.page1:
BURNING DOWN THE HOUSE

In 1984 a prison burned. The rooms are gone, but their ghosts are not.
book.burningdownthehouse.page2: A crack in a wall leads there. Whoever knows what it is can step through; everything looks flattened as you squeeze in.
book.burningdownthehouse.page3: Ghosts can be felt but pass through the living. Their food has taste and no substance. Their gun harms no one alive.
book.burningdownthehouse.page4: Any ghost fits in a pocket, however large. A piano is no heavier than a coin.
